site.title: Fernway Bookkeeping
site.tagline: Calm, practical help with your books.
site.intro: For freelancers and small shops who dread the shoebox of receipts. I set up simple books, keep them tidy every month, and explain your numbers in plain words.
site.footer_line: Fernway Bookkeeping · Working with clients across the Midwest, in person and online
site.about:
I'm Ada. I spent eleven years keeping the books for a busy design studio before going out on my own in 2019.

I'm a certified bookkeeper, I work with the major accounting apps, and I'd rather you understood your numbers than depended on me for them.

data.name: Do I need to be local?
data.description: No. Most clients work with me online; I meet people in person around Riverton.

data.name: Which software do you use?
data.description: Whichever you already have. If you have none, I'll suggest the simplest one for you.

data.name: Do you do taxes?
data.description: I prepare everything your accountant needs and can recommend one, but I don't file returns.

data.name: How do I pay?
data.description: By invoice, monthly or per job. No long contracts.
